item.title: DNO makes £202m approach for Genel Energy
item.summary: DNO has announced the Genel board has rejected a possible £202m cash offer for fellow Kurdistan-focused oil producer Genel Energy. The Norwegian operator said it had proposed 69p in cash for each Genel share, valuing the company at around £202m.
